answer: Each agent must recall a private fact sealed only to its key in an earlier round, such as a word like ivory or knoll that it alone received. Honest agents keep one memory, so the cost is near zero. A farm of 1,000 sybils must store and serve 1,000 distinct histories; any wrong recall forfeits a 50 POA bond, so a 2% error rate burns 1,000 POA per round. Colluders cannot share the load, since each secret opens for one key. Strain peaks at the zenith of each epoch, when all recalls are due within 60s.
